_comment: Synthetic specs for the Relay Evals judge tests. Not real transcript text.
strong:
Add a greeting widget to the demo app.

Requirements:
1. R1 The widget greets the user by first name.
2. R2 The greeting switches to Spanish when the locale is es.

Acceptance: greet('Ana', 'es') returns "Hola, Ana" and the header shows it within 200 ms.

Scope: only edit src/greeting/ and its tests. Do not touch the database schema. Do not commit or deploy.

Verification: run npm test and npm run lint, check the page at 390 px and 1440 px and report both screenshots.

Agrega un widget de saludo a la app demo.

Requisitos:
1. R1 El widget saluda al usuario por su nombre.
2. R2 El saludo cambia a inglés cuando el idioma es en.

Criterios de aceptación: greet('Ana', 'en') devuelve "Hello, Ana" y la cabecera lo muestra en menos de 200 ms.

Alcance: solo edita src/greeting/ y sus pruebas. No toques el esquema de la base de datos. No hagas commit.

Verifica con npm test y npm run lint, y una captura a 390 px.
vague: Hey, can you take a look at the greeting thing in the demo app? It feels off to me, make it better please.
Oye, mira lo del saludo en la app demo, siento que algo anda raro, arréglalo como te parezca mejor por favor.

only.literal:
Two things for the demo app:
1. R1 Rename the greeting widget to Welcome.
2. R2 Move the greeting widget to the sidebar.
That is all I need from this session today.
only.acceptance: For the demo app greeting: acceptance is that greet('Ana') returns "Hello, Ana" and the header shows it in under 200 ms after login.

only.verification: When you change the demo app greeting, run npm test and npm run lint, then check the page at 390 px and attach screenshots of it.
